---
- name: "Model starcoder, Problem p19, Response 9"
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
  - name: Create Ansible user
    user:
      name: ansible
      state: present
  - name: Add Ansible user to wheel group
    user:
      name: ansible
      groups: wheel
      append: yes
  - name: Enable passwordless sudo for wheel group
    lineinfile:
      dest: /etc/sudoers
      state: present
      regexp: '^%wheel'
      line: '%wheel ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL'
      validate: '/usr/sbin/visudo -cf %s'
  - name: Ensure Ansible user can sudo
    lineinfile:
      path: /etc/sudoers.d/ansible
      state: present
      create: yes
      mode: '0440'
      owner: root
      group: root
      regexp: '^ansible'
      line: 'ansible ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL'
